issue.title: Port ToggleSwitch, ToggleRow, setting cards and hub rows to native
issue.body:
**Parity unit U5** of the native UI port. The RN app must match the shipping Svelte/Capacitor app. **What to build:** | # | Primitive to build in RN | Shipping source | Tokens / specifics to port | |---|---|---|---| | P6 | `ToggleSwitch` + `ToggleRow` | `settings/ToggleSwitch.svelte`, `settings/ToggleRow.svelte` | **Switch:** 52×48 hit area; 32px pill track on `--control-track` with an inset `--icon-muted` ring, turning `--brand` when on. 26px white thumb slides 20px; optional 16px thumb icon.
**Row:** 20px icon + sm medium label + switch; help text sm `--text-soft` indented by `--setting-indent`. | | P9 | Setting card / group and `RuleLabel` | `SettingsModal.svelte` `.setting` / `.setting-group`, `settings/SectionBody.svelte`, `design/RuleLabel.svelte` | **Card:** `--surface-2`, `--radius-lg`, padding 12/16; groups 24px apart with `--setting-gap` inside.
**RuleLabel:** uppercase xs semibold with 0.14em tracking and a trailing hairline (`strong` variant: sm bold). | | P10 | `HubRow` (list row with icon) and `SidebarToc` row | `settings/HubList.svelte`, `nav/SidebarToc.svelte` | **Hub row:** `--surface-2` tile; 44px icon box with a 38px SectionIcon; md semibold title; sm `--text-soft` 2-line subtitle; 8px brand dot; optional hairline plus trailing ToggleSwitch.
**Sidebar row:** 44px; 3px `--brand` rail and `--brand-wash` when active. | **Done when:** the primitive exists in `experiments/native-architecture` with light and dark values drift-guarded against the shipping source (imported or read by a test, never hand-copied). The PR includes a specimen screenshot next to the shipping `/design` styleguide rendering of the same primitive. No visible surface changes yet, except where a caller adopting the primitive is in this unit's scope. **Order:** after U1, U2. Shipping is the spec. Read the shipping component first, then match it. The `design` skill names the vocabulary. The parity inventory that produced this issue (2026-10-13) captured screenshot pairs in `/tmp/splotch-parity/` on the build host; regenerate any you need. Part of #2690.
